text.en:
Section 1 of the Presidential Decree No. 1297 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"The importation of cattle (breeder and/or slaughter) and frozen beef (special choice cuts and/or briskets,
trimmings, and other low-cost manufacturing grade beef) shall be in accordance with the following specific
guidelines and such guidelines as may be issued by the Bureau of Animal Industry through the Ministry of
Agriculture as approved by the President.
"(a) Low-cost manufacturing grade beef such as briskets, trimmings, cow crops, shall be imported by the
government directly or through legitimate and bona-fide meat processors, in such quantities as shall be
certified by the Ministry of Agriculture upon the recommendation of the Bureau of Animal Industry, taking
into consideration the actual direct raw material requirements for processed and canned meat products
according to the actual operating capacity on officially established rated operating capacities of their
respective plants, machinery and equipment as inspected and certified by the Ministry of Industry whichever
"(b) Special choice cuts for selective institutional outlets may be imported directly by five-star hotels chains,
and such other entities authorized by the President upon recommendation of the Ministry of Tourism, subject
to the condition that the quantity and volume imported by such five-star hotels or hotel chains or other entities
shall be limited strictly to what is needed to service their own direct restaurant requirements; and
"(c) Importations by the government for breeding and/or slaughter shall be discharged and unloaded only at
the Government Cattle Breeding Grazing Reserve and Experimental Station at Busuanga, Palawan and in such
other places designated by the President upon the recommendation of the Ministry of Agriculture, at which
places continued studies and evaluation will be undertaken to determine the suitable breed of cattle that can be
properly dispersed or slaughtered to ensure protection of the local cattle industry and adequate beef supply
from certified healthy cattle at reasonable price."

Section 2 of the same decree is hereby amended to read as follows:
"All importation of live cattle for breeding and/or slaughter shall have prior approval of the Ministry of
Agriculture, upon recommendation of the Director of the Bureau of Animal Industry, attesting to the quality
and breed of the cattle to be brought in, the need for and timeliness of such importation, the cost thereof, the
benefits to be derived therefrom and the contributions such importation can make to the intended overall
economic and social objectives."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.

Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
